market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $55,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC currently ~$77,160 on Apr 29, 2026. The Feb 2026 crash bottomed near $60,033 (still above $55K). Period started Nov 24, 2025; 8 months remain until Dec 31. Hitting $55K requires ~29% drop from current spot, or just ~9% below the recent cycle low. With elevated volatility, repeated bearish patterns, and some analysts targeting $35-57K, another leg lower is plausible but not the median path.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether BTC retests/breaks the $60K February low between now and Dec 31, 2026.
